purpose: Define every reusable primitive/entity/value/relation type provided by a Universal Module as an exact identity with module ownership and machine-readable semantics.

value.identity_rule: Every machine-significant primitive/type has an explicit identity.
value.module_rule: Owning Universal Module ref is exact.
value.kind_rule: Primitive kind such as entity/value/relation/reference/state is explicit.
value.schema_rule: Primitive fields/value semantics are explicit and schema-validatable.
value.reuse_rule: Domain reuse references the same primitive identity unless the domain defines a genuinely new semantic type.
value.label_rule: Human labels are presentation/localization metadata only.
value.authority_rule: Primitive identity has no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
